say:2:1410724001:1.text: How could there be a dragon here? These are the queen's chambers!
say:2:1410724001:1.source_cn: 这里怎么会有一头龙……这里可是女王的寝殿！

choice_prompt:3:1410724001.text: How could there be a dragon here? These are the queen's chambers!
choice_prompt:3:1410724001.source_cn: 这里怎么会有一头龙……这里可是女王的寝殿！

say:5:1410724003:1.text: Queen Seralyth of Sal'thorin, of course!
say:5:1410724003:1.source_cn: 当然是萨洛克兰的女王——奈萨雷斯！

say:6:1410724004:1.text: So you're telling me your queen likes to keep dragons in her chambers...?
say:6:1410724004:1.source_cn: 你们的女王，在寝殿里，养了，一头……龙？

say:7:1410724005:1.text: She must be quite the conservationist, then. Next, you'll tell me she keeps golden moles in her closet.
say:7:1410724005:1.source_cn: 哇哦，她真是爱惜濒危物种呢！

say:8:1410724006:1.text: I'm in no mood for jokes!

say:9:1410724007:1.text: You must understand that the queen's chambers are a place of great reverence, and only a few have ever been granted entry.
say:9:1410724007:1.source_cn: 你要知道女王的寝殿尊贵无比，到访过此处的人屈指可数！

say:10:1410724008:1.text: Right, this odd hobby of raising pet dragons must be kept a secret.
say:10:1410724008:1.source_cn: 养龙这种爱好的确不能被你们知道。

say:12:1410724010:1.text: The halls may be lined with guards and servants, yet if you consider it carefully, aside from the elders and a handful of nobles, none of us have ever stood in the queen's presence.
say:12:1410724010:1.source_cn: 尽管外围有守卫和侍从，但仔细想来，除了那几位长老和部分...

say:13:1410724011:1.text: We were told that Her Majesty had fallen ill, having given herself to grant us life, and thus wished to remain undisturbed by the public.
say:13:1410724011:1.source_cn: 我们得到的说辞是，女王陛下为了赐予我们生命力，身体一直...

say:14:1410724012:1.text: What if... it's not that Her Majesty couldn't see anyone but that she couldn't be seen...
say:14:1410724012:1.source_cn: 如果……女王并非不想见人，而是不能见人呢？

say:15:1410724013:1.source_cn: 等等……我好像懂了！因度厄，你是说……

say:16:1410724014:1.text: Helthor's beard! You're not saying what I think you're saying!
say:16:1410724014:1.source_cn: 赫托的胡子！赫托的铁锤！赫托，总之赫托在下！你是说——

say:18:1410724016:0.text: But how could the queen be a dragon? Oh, no, what if the dragon eggs came from...
say:18:1410724016:0.source_cn: 但女王怎么会是龙……？我们喝的龙蛋，难道是——

say:25:1410724017:3.text: Did I not warn you long ago?
say:25:1410724017:3.source_cn: 我不是早就警告过你了吗……

say:26:1410724018:0.text: Why are you here?! Where did you come from?!
say:26:1410724018:0.source_cn: 怎么是你？你从哪里冒出来的！

say:27:1410724019:1.source_cn: 是你们不该出现在这里。

say:28:1410724020:2.text: These are the queen's chambers. No one is allowed to enter without permission.
say:28:1410724020:2.source_cn: 此为女王寝殿，不得擅自闯入。

say:30:1410724021:1.text: High Priestess Velara, General Thador, it seems that you both have known about this for quite a while but chose to hide it.
say:30:1410724021:1.source_cn: 奎茵冕下，都铎将军，你们早就知道这一切，却选择了隐瞒吗？

say:31:1410724022:0.text: Indris, none in the Essail clan hold the right to pass judgment upon the queen. We have placed our faith in her, as should you.
say:31:1410724022:0.source_cn: 因度厄，艾塞勒的任何生灵都无权评判女王。我们只是选择了...

say:33:1410724023:0.text: Oh, great! Here we go again—Feli's killer is back and spouting more twisted nonsense!
say:33:1410724023:0.source_cn: 好啊！杀害斐利尔的凶手，又开始说这些蛊惑人心的疯话了！

say:34:1410724024:2.text: The foolish have squandered their chance for redemption. Thador, erase this threat before it festers.
say:34:1410724024:2.source_cn: 愚昧之人已经丧失了被引入正途的价值。都铎，是时候将威胁...

narration:38:14010724:0.text: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.
narration:38:14010724:0.source_cn: 你们交谈之际，奎茵和都铎带来了人马挡住了你们的去路。
